about.text: Toned milk taken one step further: the fat is brought down to a minimum of 1.5 % and the non-fat solids raised to at least 9 %, by blending buffalo or cow milk with skim milk or skim milk powder and water. Sold in India as a cheap low-fat pasteurised milk, for example in pouches.
